title: About Horn and Fin
content:
Horn and Fin is a directory of hunting and fishing guides, outfitters, charters, lodges and taxidermists across the U.S., Canada and beyond. We list %%hf_listings%% businesses today, with reviews from hunters and anglers who've booked them.

What we do

Planning a hunt or a fishing trip usually means piecing together information from dozens of places. Horn and Fin puts it in one spot:

  • A directory of outfitters and guides, searchable by state, species and type of trip, from fully guided hunts to DIY access, hunting leases and discounted hunts.
  • Reviews from real trips, so you can see how a business treated the people who booked with it.
  • State hunting guides that explain how to apply, when the seasons run and what a hunt really costs.
  • Draw odds and points guides that break down every western state's tag draw and show last year's results for each hunt.

Who we're for

Horn and Fin is for hunters and anglers who want to make a good decision before they spend money on a trip, and for the outfitters, guides and landowners who want to reach them.

Our standards

  • Listings are free to add. Businesses can create an account, claim or add their listing, and keep it up to date.
  • Reviews must come from people who used the business. We remove reviews that are fake, abusive or written by the business itself.
  • Our guides are based on each state wildlife agency's published rules and results. Rules change every year, so always confirm in the current regulations before you apply or hunt.
  • Some businesses pay for featured placement. Paid placements are labeled, and paying never changes a business's reviews.

Get in touch

Questions, corrections or a listing that needs updating? Contact us or email info@hornandfin.com. Outfitters and businesses can learn about featured placement on our Advertise with us page.

title: Privacy Policy
content:
Last updated: October 21, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what information Horn and Fin ("we", "us") collects when you use hornandfin.com (the "Site"), how we use it, and the choices you have.

Information you give us

  • Account information. When you create an account we collect your username, email address and password, and any profile details you choose to add.
  • Listings. If you add or manage a business listing, we collect the business details you submit, such as name, address, phone number, website, email, photos and description. Listing details are published on the Site.
  • Reviews and comments. Reviews, ratings, photos and comments you post are published on the Site along with your display name.
  • Inquiries and contact forms. When you send a message through a listing or our contact form, we collect your name, email address, phone number if you give it, and your message. Inquiries sent through a listing are passed to that business.

Information collected automatically

When you visit the Site, we and our service providers automatically collect information such as your IP address, browser type, device, pages viewed, referring page and the date and time of your visit. This is collected with cookies, pixels and similar technologies.

Cookies and third-party services

We use the following third-party services, which may set their own cookies or collect information about your visit:

  • Google services (Google Analytics, Google Search Console and Site Kit) to measure traffic and understand how the Site is used.
  • Google AdSense to show ads. Google and its partners may use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites. You can opt out of personalized ads at Google Ad Settings or www.aboutads.info.
  • Jetpack and WordPress.com for site statistics, security and image delivery.
  • Affiliate networks, including impact.com and FlexOffers, which use cookies to track when a visit to a partner store started on our Site so we can be credited for a purchase.

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some parts of the Site, such as logging in, may not work without them.

How we use information

We use information to run and improve the Site; publish listings and reviews; create and manage accounts; pass inquiries to the businesses you contact; respond to messages; send account and listing notices; prevent fraud, spam and abuse; measure traffic; show ads; and meet legal obligations.

How we share information

We don't sell your personal information for money. We share information:

  • with the businesses you contact through the Site;
  • publicly, for listings, reviews and comments you post;
  • with service providers that host, secure and operate the Site, and with the analytics, advertising and affiliate partners listed above;
  • when required by law, or to protect the rights and safety of our users, the public or Horn and Fin;
  • as part of a sale or transfer of the Site.

Sharing information with advertising and affiliate partners through cookies may count as "sharing" or "selling" under some state privacy laws. See "Your choices and rights" below.

Your choices and rights

  • You can update your account and listing details at any time by logging in.
  • You can ask us to delete your account, or to remove a review or listing you posted, by emailing info@hornandfin.com.
  • You can opt out of marketing emails using the link in the email.
  • Depending on where you live, including California, you may have the right to know what personal information we have about you, to ask us to correct or delete it, and to opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information for targeted advertising. To make a request, email info@hornandfin.com with the subject "Privacy request." We won't discriminate against you for using these rights.
  • Your browser's "Do Not Track" signal isn't treated as an opt-out, but you can use the cookie controls and ad opt-out links above.

Data retention and security

We keep information for as long as your account is active or as needed to run the Site and meet legal obligations. Published reviews may stay on the Site after an account is closed unless you ask us to remove them. We use reasonable safeguards to protect information, but no website is completely secure.

Children

The Site is not directed to children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has given us information, contact us and we'll delete it.

Links to other websites

Listings and articles link to outfitters, stores and other websites. Their privacy practices are their own, so please review their policies.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. We'll change the date at the top when we do.

Contact us

Email info@hornandfin.com or use our contact page.

title: Affiliate Disclosure
content:
Last updated: October 21, 2026

Horn and Fin is free to use. To keep it that way, we earn money in a few ways, and we want you to know what they are.

Affiliate links

Some links on Horn and Fin go to stores and services through affiliate programs, including programs run by networks such as impact.com and FlexOffers. If you click one of these links and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

Featured and sponsored listings

Some outfitters, guides and businesses pay for featured placement, such as a higher spot in search results or a featured box on a state guide. Paid placements are labeled "Featured" or "Sponsored."

Advertising

The Site shows ads, including ads served by Google AdSense. We don't choose the individual ads you see.

What doesn't change

Payments never affect a business's reviews or ratings, and we don't let businesses remove honest reviews. Our state guides and draw odds are written from each wildlife agency's published rules and results, not from who advertises with us.

Questions? Email info@hornandfin.com.

title: Advertise with Us
content:
Horn and Fin reaches hunters and anglers while they're planning a trip and choosing who to book with. Our directory lists %%hf_listings%% outfitters, guides, charters, lodges and taxidermists, and our state hunting guides and draw odds tools draw hunters who are researching where and how to hunt.

For outfitters and businesses

Put your business in front of hunters who are ready to book

Tell us your business name, state and what you'd like to promote, and we'll send rates and availability.

Contact us

Ways to advertise

Featured listing. Your listing gets a Featured badge and moves to the top of its state and category in the directory, above standard listings.

State guide sponsorship. Be the featured outfitter in the "Find an outfitter" box on a state's hunting guide pages, such as Colorado elk or Wyoming mule deer, where hunters go to learn how to draw a tag and what a hunt costs.

Discounted and last-minute hunts. Have openings or a cancellation to fill? Feature your discounted hunts in our Discounted Hunts section and on the homepage.

Landowner tags. Landowners with transferable tags or vouchers can list them on our sister site, Landowner Tag Auctions.

Why Horn and Fin

  • The right audience. Visitors come to compare outfitters, read reviews and plan hunts and fishing trips.
  • Pages that rank for planning searches. Our state guides cover how to apply, season dates, costs and draw odds for western elk and deer.
  • Reviews from real trips. Featured placement puts your reviews in front of more hunters. Paying never changes a review.

Get started

Email info@hornandfin.com or use our contact form with your business name, the states and species you guide, and what you'd like to promote. We'll get back to you with rates and open spots.

Not listed yet? Add your listing for free first.
